pages.bodyText: ABOUT CI OVERVIEW PROFILE History Global Nongshim CI Nongshim Group more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Introduction of CI Symbol of Nongshim- Nongshim Seed carries Nongshim’s belief you reap what you sow Meaning of the symbol The symbolic mark of Nongshim is called ‘Nongshim Seed’. Seed is an essence of life in which buds and fruits will come into being. CI Morphological implications Two ellipses inside and outside the mark symbolize agility and flexibility with which the company respond to a change. The outer ellipse incorporates growth and development, and the inner ellipse symbolizes more detailed image of the seed meaning growth and development. The harmonious integration of the two implies unity and intimacy between the company and its employees & customers, and further, gratitude and honesty. The shape of the mark in which inside energy appears to be distinctly expressed outside represents our future-oriented vision to become the world’s best. Criteria for symbol size Minimum size: To secure the visibility of CI, the minimum size shall be at least 4mm (11 pixels) in principle. Space: If the CI is used without its brand signature, a space corresponding to 1/4 of the conjugate diameter shall be secured. Color system A red color symbolizes the benefits of bright and abundant nature, which is a representative color of Nongshim. It symbolizes that Nongshim is a company that produce products with sincerity of people. The secondary color is orange that expresses the warmth of the earth, expressing the infinite capacity and tolerance of the land. Nongshim Flour Mills Youlchon Foundation more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Youlchon Foundation Youlchon Foundation intends to provide more opportunity and passion to the youth through various scholarship programs and education support projects. THE YOULCHON FOUNDATION Nurturing talent and scholarship program Youlchon foundation is committed to scholarship program, projects to support academic, cultural and research activities and education projects that elevate the love and healthy passion of the youth. Hwaam Scholarship Association, which had run a scholarship program since its establishment on June 11, 1955, was taken over by chairman Shin Choon-ho, chairman of Nongshim Group in 1984 and was renamed as Youlchon Scholarship Association. In 1998, it was renamed to Youlchon Foundation, expanding the scope of support to scholarship, support for academic research, support for academic research organizations and groups, publications and distribution, and support for nature experience activities for the youth. Chairman Shin Choon-ho contributed the property of 8 billion won to the foundation after he was inaugurated as the president of the foundation and has provided an opportunity for the youth who have courage and passion to realize their dreams focusing on agricultural and vocational school students. The foundation recognized the importance of education on Chinese characters in business so it made Korean textbook for elementary school, middle school, and high school in both Korean and Chinese so that students can learn by themselves. To make the textbook, late Nam Gwang-woo, a Korean language scholar, professor Lee Eung-baik and professor Jeong Woo-sang selected Chinese characters necessary for each training course so that students can develop basic skills to learn Chinese characters and read and write masterpieces by incorporating good writings and sentences. In addition, the foundation is making an effort to make the youth, the future of us, have a good mind and proper values by participating in the project to support nature experience activities for the youth. pages.bodyText: ABOUT Nongshim Way Management Philosophy Nongshim Way more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Nongshim WAY Nongshim WAY is the standard of thoughts and actions to be always followed by Nongshim people. Farmers are Those who sow the reason of the heaven on the earth and reap the fruit. We have taken only one path with the heart of farmers. We have believed in the value of diligence, sincerity and noble sweat. As farmers cultivate the land under the force of nature, we have created today’s Nongshim by taking on new challenges with an extraordinary sense of mission. Core values Creativity·Professionalism Strong willingness and commitment to ccomplishment through endless research and creative thinking Honesty·Sincerity·Cooperation Gratitude for earnest rewards through fundamental principles of nature and having compassion to share Challenge·Passion Spirit of moving forward for a better future with continued changes and growth Nongshim WAY Nongshim Way Provide trustworthy products and services to customers. Generate opportunities with open mind and creative ideas. Aim high, accomplish without fear of failure. Take leadership with accountability. Strive for excellence through continuous learning of knowledge and technology. Make improvement continuously without being complacent with present acheivements. headings.text: From RFC 2068 Hypertext Transfer Protocol -- HTTP/1.1:

pages.bodyText: Error 404--Not Found From RFC 2068 Hypertext Transfer Protocol -- HTTP/1.1: 10.4.5 404 Not Found The server has not found anything matching the Request-URI. No indication is given of whether the condition is temporary or permanent.If the server does not wish to make this information available to the client, the status code 403 (Forbidden) can be used instead. The 410 (Gone) status code SHOULD be used if the server knows, through some internally configurable mechanism, that an old resource is permanently unavailable and has no forwarding address.

pages.title: Error 404--Not Found

headings.text: From RFC 2068 Hypertext Transfer Protocol -- HTTP/1.1:

pages.bodyText: Error 404--Not Found From RFC 2068 Hypertext Transfer Protocol -- HTTP/1.1: 10.4.5 404 Not Found The server has not found anything matching the Request-URI. No indication is given of whether the condition is temporary or permanent.If the server does not wish to make this information available to the client, the status code 403 (Forbidden) can be used instead. The 410 (Gone) status code SHOULD be used if the server knows, through some internally configurable mechanism, that an old resource is permanently unavailable and has no forwarding address.

pages.bodyText: 인생을 맛있게, 농심 Lovely Life Lovely Food 인생을 맛있게, 농심 Lovely Life Lovely Food Add Value To Your Daily Life Add Value To Your Daily Life Add Happy Value To Your Life Add Happy Value To Your Life Lovely Life Lovely Food Lovely Life Lovely Food The taste representing Korea, the taste that touches the heart of the world Nongshim Mission A powerful takeoff to become a global food company, Nongshim moves toward the world together with customers. History It is the footsteps of Nongshim which has been writing a new history of the Korean food culture. Nongshim Vision It has become a company representing Korea with its philosophy that has been consistent for 60 years. About The world which becomes more beautiful together, is being led by Nongshim CSR Nongshim wants to create a world where we live together and the future with happiness based on the practice of giving back. ENVIRONMENT ·SAFETY We put top priority on the health and happiness of customers through safe manufacturing process and food production. CONSUMER -ORIENTED MANAGEMENT Nongshim conducts consumer-focused management and improves relevant management activities continuously. Sustainability Bringing joy to everyone’s daily life. Best Brand Instant Noodles Communicating with the world through the taste of Korea. Snacks Creating the history of a long-lasting brand BOTTLED WATER Opening the future of premium bottled water brand HOME MEAL REPLACEMENT Delicious and delightful simple dish Products Taste of Nongshim that transcends national borders China United States Canada Japan Australia Vietnam Spicy taste of Nongshim that local Chinese people really like We are making the premium image take root across China with the unique taste of Nongshim based on our pride in product quality. With the goal of becoming the best brand in the US market Nongshim products have joined the ranks of global brands known and sought by US consumers beyond the Korean community in the US. Introducing the taste of Nongshim to the North America beyond the US As of 2018, Nongshim ranked No.2 in terms of Ramyun market share in Canada. Nongshim’s ramyun products recognized well in Korea and other countries are also being loved by Canadians. Nongshim leading the spicy ramyun market in Japan Nongshim is making an effort to be the No.1 spicy ramyun in the competitive Japanese ramyun market by strengthening brand power centering around Shin Ramyun. The spicy taste of Nongshim that fascinated Oceania Nongshim is pushing ahead with its efforts to target Oceania through Nongshim Australia and is currently selling Shin Ramyun products through Woolworths and Coles, the two largest retail companies in Australia. Establishing Nongshim Vietnam in the hub of Southeast Asia Nongshim is promoting the taste of Nongshim across Vietnam through Nongshim Vietnam in Ho Chi Minh. Furthermore, it will leap toward becoming the hub in the Southeast Asian region. Global Nongshim

pages.bodyText: PR CENTER Shinramyun Cup World Baduk Championship more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Shinramyun Cup World Baduk Championship Nongshim, corp. holds Shinramyun Cup World Baduk Championship for the development of Baduk and enthusiastic fans of Baduk. “Shin Ramyun Cup World Baduk Championship is the only world team championship between countries, which is proceeded in the method of successive winning, where each 5 players of Korea, China and Japan participate.” Since the first championship in 1999, it has settled down to the best world Baduk championship. Nongshim Shin Ramyun Cup World Baduk Championship is leading the popularity of Asian Baduk and is welcomed especially by Chinese Baduk fans. pages.bodyText: 라면피디아 NongshimRamyunPedia What is Ramyun Definition of Ramyun Merits of Ramyun Types of Ramyun History of Ramyun Advancement of Ramyun How to make Ramyun Noodles Soup powder Soup flakes NongshimRamyunPedia NongshimRamyunPedia WHAT IS RAMYUN Scroll Down DEFINITION OF RAMYUN DEFINITION OF RAMYUN -01 Birth of ramyun How can we explain ramyun? Ramyun is an instant food made of noodle that is steamed, fried then dried and of soup base. Fried Noodle Soup Powder DEFINITION OF RAMYUN -02 Birth of ramyun Only fried noodle is ramyun? With the recent changes in the market, dried noodle, cold noodle, rice noodle which are not fried are newly introduced as wellness products. Nongshim's Vegetable Ramyun, Doongji Cold Noodle, Hooroorook, Rice Chajangmyun Champong, and Tteokguk Noodle soup are instant dried noodles which are easy to eat with the features of existing ramyun. These are broadly included in the category of Ramyun. MERITS OF RAMYUN MERITS OF RAMYUN -01 Ramyun has many merits Simple food for all! Ramyun became a beloved and popular food for it is easy to cook and eat. Ramyun is easy to cook quickly Anyone can easily cook ramyun as it takes only three to five minutes if there is only boiling water. Ramyun is available anywhere With its small volume and high portability, ramyun is available anywhere. It is exported to more than 100 countries and one can purchase it anywhere around the world. MERITS OF RAMYUN -02 Ramyun has many merits Ramyun has long shelf life Ramyun has a long shelf life of 5~6 months without refrigeration/freezing. This is because the moisture content is maintained below 10% (practically 4~8%) where no microbe can survive. Thus, ramyun contains no preservative. Ramyun is highly economical The price of Ramyun is half of that of other meal replacements. It may be the most economical food considering its rich ingredients. This cheap price is possible due to mass purchase of raw ingredients. MERITS OF RAMYUN -03 Ramyun has many merits Ramyun is a meal replacement One pack of ramyun has enough calories and nutrition to replace one meal and provides satisfaction after eating. It is good enough without any side dish and it is easy to eat in any situation where table setting is unavailable. Various types and flavors of ramyun There are so many different types and flavors of ramyun and it is impossible to try all of them. Among famous Ramyun bloggers, one reviewed more than 600 types of ramyun. MERITS OF RAMYUN -04 Ramyun has many merits Ramyun can be applied in various ways Cheap and easy-to-get ramyun can be used as an ingredient for various cooking not only by adolescents but also by professional chefs. It also became a source of new culinary culture as fusion ramyun, such as Chapaguri, appears by concocting ramyun of different features. TYPES OF RAMYUN TYPES OF RAMYUN -01 There are different types of ramyun classified by the method of manufacturing the noodles Current ramyun in the domestic market can be categorized as below by the method of manufacturing the noodle. Fried noodle products 01 Fried noodles Fried noodle is made by steaming and then frying it with oil. Steamed noodle is fried in oil heated up to 150˚C to lower the moisture content below 10% where no microbe can propagate. Nongshim controls the moisture of fried noodle below 7% for the longer shelf life without preservative. In the process, steamed noodle further becomes easy to cook and gets the unique flavor of ramyun. TYPES OF RAMYUN -02 There are different types of ramyun classified by the method of manufacturing the noodles Dried noodle products 02 Dried noodles Dried noodle is not fried but dried with hot air after steaming. Steamed noodles or hot air dried noodles are dried through the hot air drier for about 30 minutes. Compared with fried noodles, the cooking time is longer but the oil content is lower and it gives a clean taste. Ingredient 1 pack of SHINRAMYUN, 550ml of water, 2 eggs, 2 aged tomatoes, tomato paste 5g, green onion 40g, chives 15g, oil 20g Recipe 1 Remove the top of the tomatoes and slash in a crisscross pattern with a knife. 2 Wash green onion and chives and remove the roots. headings.text: Establishing an autonomous fair trade compliance system
Increase transparency and fairness in trade relationships

pages.bodyText: SUSTAINABILITY Compliance Management Board of Directors Compliance Management more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Compliance management Nongshim establishes transparent and fair compliance standards and practices them. What is compliance? Nongshim practices compliance management to promote the conduct of business in a fair and transparent manner, pursue sound development of the company and secure trust from consumers by complying with applicable laws. Nongshim prevents illegal acts in advance by identifying applicable laws to be complied with for running a business and checking whether employees and executives comply with laws internally. In addition, we are establishing policies and conducting supporting activities to respond to various kinds of legal risks systematically. Establishing an autonomous fair trade compliance system Establishment of a compliance management system, internal education, and organization of a department dedicated to the promotion of fair trade. Increase transparency and fairness in trade relationships Four major practices, the introduction of standard subcontracting/agent contracts, and the operation of internal deliberation councils. Strategy/direction of compliance management We are running a compliance support system. We are preventing legal risks in advance by running a compliance organization conducting internal inspection and evaluating and managing legal risks. We provide legal training for executives and employees on Civil and Commercial Law, Fair Trade Act, Subcontract Act, Overseas Contract Act. Compliance management policy (Nongshim Compliance Declaration) Nongshim executives and employees comply with domestic and overseas laws and corporate criteria for compliance in the process of conducting all business activities and practice the following principles. Nongshim executives and employees comply with domestic and overseas laws and corporate criteria for compliance in the process of conducting all business activities and practice the following principles 1Comply with the company’s compliance standards and routinize legislation and contract reviews. 2Internalize the compliance of business and make an effort to improve the awareness of compliance and establish the proper image of Nongshim. 3Comply with applicable laws related to the provision of information and services to customers. 4Understand and comply with laws related to intellectual property rights, personal information, food and environment. 5Do not conduct any activities against laws for the benefit of the company. 6Do not follow wrong practices and if the illegal activities are known, they should be notified to the company. 7Do not conduct any illegal trade or unfair joint activities in the conduct of business. 8Do not engage in embezzlement, negligence, conflict of interest with the company or insider trading 9Do not disclose the business secrets learned while performing jobs and follow security rules in daily activities. 10Do not provide or receive any bribe, money or entertainment or other illegal economic benefits to and from domestic and overseas public officials and influential persons. Efforts for compliance Fair Trade Act Laws related to environment Area related to Food Safety Act Related to Personal Information Protection Act. pages.bodyText: SUSTAINABILITY Youlchon Foundation Win-Win Growth Safety & Health Social Contribution Youlchon Foundation more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Youlchon Foundation Making a world where we live together for tomorrow’s happiness, it is a small start of Youlchon Foundation. EDUCATION Scholarship Programs Support for Academic Research Running a Youth Training Facility Publications and Distribution Support for Academic Research Organizations and Groups Scholarship Programs Youlchon Foundation (栗忖財團) has provided scholarship to middle school, high school, university students and graduate school students who are excellent in academic performance with talent so that they can exert their full potential in various fields. Recently, we are aiming to cultivate human resources who will lead Korea in the future by expanding the scope of basic natural sciences, new materials, genetic engineering, information and communication fields, and environmental fields to master's and doctoral students and overseas students. Support for Academic Research Nongshim believes that the basic purpose of searching for truth and studying science is to create a society where we all enjoy happiness together. The Youlchon Foundation does not spare any support so that dedicated researchers with this sense of mission in each field can produce fruitful outcome from their academic research. In particular, we are contributing to the establishment of a foundation for research capabilities that can provide academic development and basic technology in the future food field by supporting projects on basic research for future food. Youth training facility operation Youlchon Foundation (栗忖財團) is planning to operate a youth training facility where young students can explore natural ecosystem to experience and learn the importance of the natural environment so that they can learn that our life and the natural environment are not separated but one. Support for Academic Research Organizations and Groups We support research activities by selecting academic research institutes or organizations that are active in various fields in the society with a clear sense of purpose, and endeavors to make such research activities contribute to the benefit and development of society as a whole. Publications and Distribution We support the publication of research papers through academic research support activities, and distribute them widely to improve the overall profits of society. And at the same time, we also contribute to the continuous development of the academic research field by publishing and supporting excellent research cases and academic papers in each field. We recognize the importance of education on Chinese characters to understand our language and history. Accordingly we have compiled and distributed textbooks written in both Korean and Chinese. This textbook was completed through 10 years of research with more than 150 experts in each field, and Chinese characters of 1,000 letters for elementary school, 400 letters for middle school, and 400 letters for high school were used to teach Korean words and their meanings correctly. The understanding of Korean characters and the use of Chinese characters will contribute to understanding, inheriting, and developing our history and traditional culture. In addition, the combination of the connotation and abbreviation of Chinese characters and its infinite coining power enriches the vocabulary of Korean words. This textbook makes students easily access our traditional culture, prestigious texts, and masterpieces. Response to Climate Change Environmental Management System All the plants of Nongshim have obtained ISO 14001 certification. Based on the environmental management system, all plants have established environmental management strategies and carried out action tasks throughout the entire process from procurement of raw materials to disposal after sales. Four plants have been designated as green companies. Green company certification is awarded through an examination by the Ministry of Environment to companies that actively carry out preventive environmental management and improvement activities as well as proper treatment of pollutants with the participation of all members of the organization. Environmental Policy and Action Plans Environmental Policy We declare that we adopt and abide by environmental management to preserve clean environment and pass on a better future to next generations. ① Continuous environmental improvement activities should be conducted through preventive measures. ② Repay society and customers by making good products in a good environment. Practical Tasks for Environmental Management ① Nongshim is committed to conserving resources and energy, and continuously strives to reduce greenhouse gas and other emissions. ② Nongshim minimizes the generation of environmental pollutants through active pollution prevention throughout manufacturing and voluntarily participates in activities to protect the surrounding ecosystem. ③ Nongshim complies with environmental laws and creates and faithfully implements in-house standards that are stricter than legal ones. ④ Nongshim thoroughly identifies and evaluates the environmental impacts and legal requirements related to its activities, products, and services. ⑤ Nongshim will continue implementing practical tasks to complete its environmental management system. For sustainable packaging, we are collaborating with various stakeholders across the value chain and contributing to the spread of a sustainable consumption culture by sharing best practices in sustainable packaging with them. # Story 1 Mono-material film packaging # BbangBuJang # Chochung U-Gua # Welch's Soda PET Bottle Label Nongshim is actively advancing mono-material film packaging to improve the recyclability of its product packaging and strengthen resource circularity. In October 2024, Nongshim expanded the application of olefin-based mono-material packaging to two snack products, PpangBuJang and Chochung U-Gua, replacing conventional multi-layer composite materials. Previously, the packaging used vapor-deposited PET, known for its excellent oxygen and moisture barrier properties. However, this material posed challenges in recycling, as it could not be extruded during the process. To overcome this, Nongshim independently developed a high-barrier vapor-deposited OPP film, enabling all five layers of the packaging to be made from olefin-based materials, thereby significantly enhancing recyclability In parallel, Nongshim has also been working to simplify material composition in its beverage packaging. pages.bodyText: SUSTAINABILITY Consumer Centered Management R&D Consumer Centered Management more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan Consumer Centered Management Nongshim is making an effort to promote consumer rights and contributing to the welfare of the customers through customer centered management (CCM) certification. What is consumer centered management (CCM) certification? It is the system to review and certify whether a company organizes all activities conducted by the company focusing on consumers from the perspective of consumers and improves relevant business activities continuously. LEADERSHIP SYSTEM Introduction of CCM certification What criteria should be used for consumers to choose many products that are coming out everyday? consumer centered management (CCM) CCM is a system that evaluates and certifies that all corporate activities from product planning to production promotion, sales and consumer complaints handling are conducted focusing on consumers. Consumers can choose wisely by checking certification marks on products, product descriptions, receipts, and homepages of companies that have received CCM certification. The CCM certification started evaluation in 2007 and since then, excellent companies and public institutions obtained the certification. CCM certification system is more reliable as it is certified by the Korea Fair Trade Commission and managed by Korea Consumer Agency. CCM is the symbol of a company which respects customers who are guiding the wide consumption culture. CaptionClose Expected benefits of CCM Consumers If issues arise, that can be handled in a prompt and reasonable manner according to CCM operating system. Company A company can have efficient management culture where the whole company relates to and think of consumer problems. Nongshim obtained CCM to achieve zero claims and secure CS competitiveness at the global level and in 2020, it won CCM of the Year Awards. pages.bodyText: SUSTAINABILITY R&D R&D Consumer Centered Management more option print Facebook twitter URL Scan R&D We've tried our best to develop various products through continuously investing on R & D and innovating related systems, and provide customers with safe and healthy food. R&D Center Developing safe and healthy food with the mind of an honest farmer Since its foundation in 1965, Nongshim has devoted itself to developing food that attracts the taste of Korean people and global market based on its own technology developed through R&D activities. Nongshim R&D develops noodles, snacks , beverages, and convenient foods, and also conducts sustainable research on food ingredients, future food, nutrition & health benefits of functional foods, bioengineering, culinary science, and packaging technology to provide safe food as a global food company. In addition, it is securing cutting-edge technology for food safety that customers can trust and eat by possessing world-class food analysis and safety technologies. Product development Globalization of the taste of Korea using a global R&D network Nongshim is striving to improve cutting-edge technology based on the three spirits of ‘craftsmanship’, ‘pioneering customer needs’, and ‘creating new tastes’ as a leading Korean food company. Nongshim's product development spirit is incorporated in the history of new product launches. Products that were developed and launched by Nongshim for the first time include ‘Jajangmyeon', 'snack’, ‘Naengmyeon' (making it processed food for the first time in the world), and 'extruded rice noodles'. Nongshim seeks and develops healthy natural materials using fermentation technology and efficacy evaluation technology, and applies them to its products. In addition, it is focusing on research on fermented ingredients such as Cheonggukjang and Doenjang by paying attention to the functionality of Korean traditional healthy ingredients. Nongshim is constantly researching natural food materials that can be applied to products through the development of new functional peptides to prevent lifestyle-related diseases, aging, and obesity, development of technologies to improve bioavailability and protein processing technology, maintenance of functionality, and development of alternative materials. In addition, we intend to design and maintain optimal nutritional balance through constant communication with customers. To this end, Nongshim is conducting research on healthy eating habits of noodles and development of future-oriented products. It is designing products that can improve health and nutritional value through nutrition and metabolism studies of processed foods. Nongshim has been operating a testing laboratory accredited by the Korea Laboratory Accreditation Scheme (KOLAS) for the first time in the industry in 1997. In addition, we have the highest level of food analysis technology in Korea, and use state-of-the-art analysis equipment to ensure product quality and safety. Nongshim is developing products with food safety as the top priority from the development stage, and is also making efforts to develop technologies to reduce harmful substances in order to provide safe food to customers. Nongshim is the first in the industry to acquire HACCP for all products in all factories by producing products with strict hygiene and safety management standards to all stages from raw materials to finished products. Packaging is the face of our products. The packaging of Nongshim products is designed to be easy to use and accurately recognized from the perspective of consumers by introducing the concept of universal packaging. Nongshim utilizes global R&D networks around the world to develop the highest quality products to spread our tastes to the world. It operates systematically from or It operates an organized system from production to management to standardize taste and strengthen product power. pages.bodyText: Error 404--Not Found From RFC 2068 Hypertext Transfer Protocol -- HTTP/1.1: 10.4.5 404 Not Found The server has not found anything matching the Request-URI. No indication is given of whether the condition is temporary or permanent.If the server does not wish to make this information available to the client, the status code 403 (Forbidden) can be used instead. The 410 (Gone) status code SHOULD be used if the server knows, through some internally configurable mechanism, that an old resource is permanently unavailable and has no forwarding address.
